The '''''Recusant''-class light destroyer''', also known as the '''''Recusant''-class support destroyer''', commonly referred to as the '''Commerce Guild destroyer''', and additionally known as the '''Separatist destroyer''', were a class of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
===Dimensions===
The ''Recusant''-class, like the vast majority of the Confederacy's [[Warship/Legends|warships]], was largely controlled by automated [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] technology. This proved to be a flaw, however, for the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brain had a lower reaction time, which caused it to run into other ships often. However, little crew space was required. This gave the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] a sinister, skeletal appearance.<ref name="ROTSICS" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
[[File:Recusant_cross-section.jpg|thumb|left|250px|''Recusant''-class cross-section, depicting (from left to right): Thrusters, [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannon, empty internal space, bridge.]]

The ''Recusant''-class destroyer was a light CIS warship armed with oversized guns, similar to the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]], and carried a heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannon on its prow.

Additional weapons consisted of four heavy turbolasers, six heavy turbolaser turrets, five turbolaser cannons, thirty dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], twelve dual light laser cannons, and sixty [[Point-defense laser cannon/Legends|point-defense cannons]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

Should the main shields be destroyed during battle, the interior hull could be vulnerable to severe damage.<ref name="wizards" />

===Propulsion systems===
The vessel had three isolated thrusters positioned at the stern, remotely connected to the ship's main reactor, which was located inside the main superstructure.<ref name="ROTSICS" /> While this provided substantial thrust and speed for the ship, the engine segments were susceptible to being severed from sustained fire due to the somewhat thin structure of that area of the ship.

===Complement===
The stock ''Recusant'' was not equipped with hangars for ground based forces, but carried about 40,000 [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] for boarding actions. The ''Recusant''-class could also carry [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] for fleet engagements in hollow spaces inside the ship.<ref name="ROTSICS" />
A 2,544 meter-long variant model<ref name="TCW:IV" /> was shown to have both a built-in hangar on each side of the vessel, as well as a docking clamp to carry one [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

===Bridge tower===
The ''Recusant''-class's forward command center protruded from the forward part of the superstructure, in a manner similar to the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

==History==
<div style="float:right">[[File:RecusantCrash.png|thumb|left|200px|An errant ''Recusant''-class light [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] collides with a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].]]</div>

===Separatist use===
The ''Recusant''-class was based on technical schematics stolen from the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] by [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] Separatists.<ref name="SOTG07" /> It was mass-produced by zealous workers led by [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foremen]], using materials from many Commerce Guild [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. The Commerce Guild destroyer was manufactured by [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]] and [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

This class was fielded from early on in the Clone Wars. They were donated to the Separatist cause by hundreds of star sectors eager to defend their independence. During the war, large numbers of this vessel were built, destroyed in battle, and replaced. ''Recusant''s were often used to carry out raids on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] commercial shipping, though prey in large number sometimes proved deadly.<ref name="ROTSICS" />

Commerce Guild destroyers were most effective when deployed in large numbers, like most Confederate military units. Four to six Commerce Guild destroyers could easily defeat a Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] or [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. However, a thousand ''Recusant''s were needed to successfully engage a [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Mandator II-class Star Dreadnaught/Legends|''Mandator II''-class Star Dreadnaught]].<ref name="ROTSICS" /> During the height of the Clone Wars, it was unusual to see the class deployed in groups of less than four ships. A major flaw of the class was its stubbornness in battle. A ''Recusant'' would continue to attack a chosen target until it was destroyed or disabled, and ignore other enemy units during this process.<ref name="SOTG07" />

The ''Recusant''-class destroyers were employed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in battles<ref name="OEG:S1-2">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|near the Arda system]], [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|at Saleucami]],<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> and [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|at Kamino]].<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref> ''Recusant''s were used extensively in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], where they engaged similarly large numbers of ''Venators''. One ''Recusant'' was seen colliding with a friendly ''Munificent''. They also formed the defense line that protected the CIS flagship [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

===Later use===
[[File:Recusantrebel.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ''Recusant''-class destroyer in formation with [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruisers]].]]
A derelict ''Recusant'' vessel was used by a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to allow them to escape from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|subjugation of Kashyyyk]] a few weeks after the end of the Clone Wars.<ref name="DL:TRODV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

Following the formal end of the Wars, the ''Recusant''-class went on to serve various fleets throughout the galaxy. A half dozen ''Recusant''s were employed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="SOTG07" /> At least one vessel was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. It was heavily modified to accommodate a larger, organic crew.<ref name="SOTG07" />

One ''Recusant'' was used to make up a [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|secret Jedi retreat]] in [[137 ABY]].<ref name="SWL25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref>
